candidates.description: This feature represents common Italian words, pronouns, and functional modifiers frequently used in everyday discourse.
This feature vector represents the concept of large bodies of water and coastal environments, specifically oceans, seas, and their associated geographical or meteorological features.
This vector represents common adjectives describing physical or scalar properties such as size, color, speed, and quality.
This vector represents word roots and suffixes associated with completion, inclusion, and scale.
This feature activates on words, roots, and prefixes containing Italian and Romance language demonstratives and interrogatives (e.g., "questo", "questa", "essa").
This vector represents roots or prefixes related to continuity, persistence, and experience across various languages.
This vector represents Italian verb stems and inflectional suffixes related to indication and verification.
This vector represents sub-word tokens containing the letters 'sp' or variations of the 'sp' phonetic sound.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the lowercase letter sequence "u" following a consonant, often at the start of subwords.
This feature vector activates on words ending with the "-are" or "-ire" rhyming suffix, particularly in Italian and English terms.
